name: 67654 · Norton, KS
findings: ZIP 67654 (Norton) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67654 (Norton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67654 (Norton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.
